Museum Object Identification Lab

A two-hour museum visit at a Delhi museum chosen with you

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this visit you learn object description and provenance cautions.

The gallery, date, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Cataloguing method
  • Replica records
  • Contextual checks
  • Presentation

How the time is spent

  1. Cataloguing method 30 min

    Terminology, measurements and condition categories.

    You: template

  2. Replica records 30 min

    Make accession-style practice entries on owned replicas.

    You: five records

  3. Contextual checks 30 min

    Test claims against label and provenance.

    You: revise catalogue

  4. Presentation 30 min

    Explain evidence and uncertainty.

    You: two-minute pitch

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

A portfolio of your work from each session.
